Demo46 竜の王と、エルフの王と、小悪魔 — prompts for the layered art (DEMO_DESIGN_GUIDE §6, §6.5) → project/web_prompts.json for
tools/openai/images.py (Seedance API upload rate-limited 2026-11-09 → OpenAI per §5.3). Keeps the option jobs of scripts/design_options.py.

USER PICKS 2026-11-09: 陽向 C (plum page-boy butler, half-cape, tea tray, small horns + bat wings + devil tail), 岳 C (high-collar black
royal coat with green-silver embroidery, his own fringe over one eye, slim black horns, dragon tail, wings folded), 蓮 A (silver-white
robe + ice-crystal crown, long silver hair, elf ears). The options were drawn on #d8d8d8 → the bases are redrawn on the card screens:
陽向 / 蓮 chroma GREEN #00B140 ("matte": "green"), 岳 light grey #c8c8c8 (dark figure). Faces stay those of the options (= the
characters' lock faces). Mouths = LivePortrait sets; blinks = masked edits (project/face_points.json).
Run: python3 scripts/design_options.py && python3 scripts/prompts.py

hinata_base.prompt:
Image 1 is the exact CHARACTER DESIGN to keep (same face, eyes, hair, outfit, pose, proportions); image 2 is his face reference. Redraw image 1 at full quality, closer, on a different plain background.

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern anime illustration, thin coloured lineart, soft cel shading with one soft-edged shadow layer, romantic otome-game card quality, not glossy, no bloom, not realistic, not 3D. Realistic adult proportions (7.5 heads). He is EXTREMELY handsome: idol-level face, clear jawline, long lashes, no stubble. A storybook Western-fantasy world: nothing modern, no glasses, no earbuds.

Hinata (the little-devil butler): fluffy messy soft PINK hair with long bangs, warm amber eyes, a sly sweet smile with a tiny fang, a small silver star stud earring; a plum velvet page-boy butler outfit (short jacket, bow tie, knee breeches, white stockings), a short black half-cape, tiny black horns in the pink fluff, small round bat wings, a thin devil tail.

Same pose as image 1 but framed CLOSER: from the thighs up, the figure large in the frame (his head about one sixth of the picture height), centred, at eye level, looking at the viewer, wings / tail / cape may be cut by the bottom edge only. Mouth CLOSED.

Lighting on him: warm firelight from the RIGHT of the picture, cool window light from the LEFT.

Plain flat GREEN background (#00B140), one even colour, completely empty: no scenery, no floor line, no shadow, no gradient, no green anywhere on him. His whole head, horns / ears and hair inside the frame with space above; shoulders, arms and elbows not cut by the left or right picture edge. ONLY the character: no furniture, no fire, no other people, no other hands.

Wide 16:9 game art. No text, no letters, no captions, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI, no readable writing anywhere.
